parts.name: hull_top
parts.note: Clamshell upper half: skin, kick saddle (worm N20 drops in, strap groove, Ø3 shaft holes both sides), ear fin with an F693ZZ for the hub screw, both drill-axle bosses (Ø7 coupler bores, teardrop roofs), wire holes. Radial M3 clearance at z=+3 into tray disc 1 and the tail spigot
parts.orient: split face down (on the bed), saddle up

parts.name: hull_bottom
parts.note: Clamshell lower half: plain Ø42 cylinder (launcher cradle surface). Radial M3 clearance at z=-3 into tray disc 1 and the tail spigot

parts.name: nose
parts.note: Blunt hollow nose: Ø22 flat tip with the Ø9.8 lens hole, Caddx Ant pocket 14.4 x 15.0 (slides in from the back, 1.2 lip + lens recess hold it), 1.5 walls; spigot with a groove that the hull rib locks when the clamshell closes
parts.orient: tip down on the bed (flat Ø22), spigot up

parts.name: tail_cap
parts.note: Tail cap: carries the tether (two Ø4.2 holes, chamfered both ends, through a 3.5 mm end wall: line goes in one, round the web, out the other, knot; the knot sits in the launcher pusher's Ø14 hole), 4 radial M3 from the hull into its spigot ring so the tether load goes into the hull. Top: recessed seat for the JST-XH 2-pin power loop socket (the ON plug, reachable with the dart on the launcher). Bottom: recessed seat for the JST-XH 3-pin charge socket (bench only)
parts.orient: end face down, spigot up (no supports)

parts.name: tray
parts.note: One-piece spine nose to tail: disc 1 (4 radial M3 from the hull), sled (deploy-N20 cradle, MP1584 on the keel, DRV8833 #3 shelf), disc 2, 3 decks (BNO085 / XIAO + DRV#1 / DRV#2 + INA219), disc 3, cell bay (2 x 18350 side by side on saddles, BMS stick under them, VTX deck over them), disc 4. Battery contact recesses for a 2xAA-holder contact set
parts.orient: keel down on the bed; discs stand up, decks bridge 26 mm between discs

parts.name: kick_leg
parts.note: Kick leg: Ø12 x 14 hub, D-bore on the worm N20 output shaft (1:1 pivot), M3 x 10 screw from outside through the ear F693ZZ into the hub end; Ø8 pole with a Ø4.6 wire channel, foot housing with the foot worm N20 in line, output shaft up when folded / down when deployed
parts.orient: on its side (pole axis horizontal, hub face down)

parts.name: foot_auger
parts.note: Foot auger Ø13 x 40, core Ø6, right-hand flight, D-bore on the foot N20 output shaft (7 mm engaged), M3 grub screw in the hub; its base runs 0.3 over the housing so drilling push goes into the housing, not the worm gearbox

parts.name: drill_leg_L
parts.note: Drill pod: round clevis head on the Ø7 D coupler (counterbore for the pod cap outside, flat front face lands on the hull's deploy stop horn), 14.8 x 12.8 housing: 1.2 mm terminal room (bend the motor tabs up), motor drops in from the top (zip-tie groove), 0.6 mm gap to the M3 nut (gearbox bushing), inner F693ZZ (flange toward the motor), outer F693ZZ (flange on the nose face), back to back: the nut on the inner race takes the auger's pull, the auger base on the outer inner race takes push; the gearbox carries torque only. Bottom nose edge chamfered for ground clearance
parts.orient: upright, motor pocket open to the top (as installed folded)

parts.name: drill_leg_L_auger
parts.note: Auger Ø13 x 72.8, right-hand flight (the pair counter-rotates, so the two are mirror images and both screw IN), Ø6 core (bending at the base under the 55 N tow), captive M3 nyloc in a side slot near the point, its flat Ø6 core end bears on the outer bearing's inner race and stands on the bed when printing (brim 8 mm)

parts.name: drill_leg_L_motor
parts.note: Drill motor 12 x 10 x 24.27 (measured)

parts.name: drill_leg_L_shaft
parts.note: M3 threaded motor shaft Ø2.84 x 56.03 (measured)

parts.name: drill_leg_L_brg1
parts.note: F693ZZ inner, flange toward the motor

parts.name: drill_leg_L_brg2
parts.note: F693ZZ outer, flange on the nose face

parts.name: drill_leg_L_nut
parts.note: M3 nut on the shaft, tightened against the inner bearing's inner race (threadlocker)

parts.name: drill_leg_L_nyloc
parts.note: M3 nyloc captive in the auger, threadlocker on it

parts.name: drill_leg_R
parts.note: Drill pod: round clevis head on the Ø7 D coupler (counterbore for the pod cap outside, flat front face lands on the hull's deploy stop horn), 14.8 x 12.8 housing: 1.2 mm terminal room (bend the motor tabs up), motor drops in from the top (zip-tie groove), 0.6 mm gap to the M3 nut (gearbox bushing), inner F693ZZ (flange toward the motor), outer F693ZZ (flange on the nose face), back to back: the nut on the inner race takes the auger's pull, the auger base on the outer inner race takes push; the gearbox carries torque only. Bottom nose edge chamfered for ground clearance
parts.orient: upright, motor pocket open to the top (as installed folded)

parts.name: drill_leg_R_auger
parts.note: Auger Ø13 x 72.8, left-hand flight (the pair counter-rotates, so the two are mirror images and both screw IN), Ø6 core (bending at the base under the 55 N tow), captive M3 nyloc in a side slot near the point, its flat Ø6 core end bears on the outer bearing's inner race and stands on the bed when printing (brim 8 mm)

parts.name: drill_leg_R_motor
parts.note: Drill motor 12 x 10 x 24.27 (measured)

parts.name: drill_leg_R_shaft
parts.note: M3 threaded motor shaft Ø2.84 x 56.03 (measured)

parts.name: drill_leg_R_brg1
parts.note: F693ZZ inner, flange toward the motor

parts.name: drill_leg_R_brg2
parts.note: F693ZZ outer, flange on the nose face

parts.name: drill_leg_R_nut
parts.note: M3 nut on the shaft, tightened against the inner bearing's inner race (threadlocker)

parts.name: drill_leg_R_nyloc
parts.note: M3 nyloc captive in the auger, threadlocker on it

parts.name: coupler_L
parts.note: Ø7 D coupler: D-socket on the deploy N20 output stub, runs through the hull boss into the pod head; its outer end stands 0.3 proud in the pod counterbore, the printed pod cap and an M3 x 8 screw seat on it, so the pod is held on (0.7 mm float) but never clamped against the boss. Print in PPA-CF lying on the flat: a nose-first landing on gravel bends it about 69 MPa (dart-physics), over PLA's 45
parts.orient: lying on its D flat (layers along the axle), PPA-CF

parts.name: coupler_R
parts.note: Ø7 D coupler: D-socket on the deploy N20 output stub, runs through the hull boss into the pod head; its outer end stands 0.3 proud in the pod counterbore, the printed pod cap and an M3 x 8 screw seat on it, so the pod is held on (0.7 mm float) but never clamped against the boss. Print in PPA-CF lying on the flat: a nose-first landing on gravel bends it about 69 MPa (dart-physics), over PLA's 45
parts.orient: lying on its D flat (layers along the axle), PPA-CF

parts.name: cell_1
parts.note: 18350 Ø18.66 x 36.87 incl. button (measured), 2S, contacts both ends

parts.name: cell_2
parts.note: 18350 Ø18.66 x 36.87 incl. button (measured), 2S, contacts both ends

parts.name: n20_kick
parts.note: KICK worm N20 (33.04 long), worm box at the nose end; output shaft across Y = the kick pivot

parts.name: kick_shaft
parts.note: kick N20 output shaft (turns with the leg), 29.97 tip to tip

parts.name: n20_deploy
parts.note: DEPLOY worm N20 on the axle line, body forward in the tray cradle

parts.name: deploy_shaft
parts.note: deploy N20 output shaft (turns with the couplers), both stubs in the couplers

parts.name: xiao
parts.note: xiao 17.74 x 22.75 x 4.49 (measured)

parts.name: ina219
parts.note: ina219 25.69 x 20.32 x 4.70 (measured)

parts.name: bno085
parts.note: bno085 22.77 x 25.72 x 4.77 (measured)

parts.name: vtx
parts.note: vtx 42.25 x 19.91 x 6.01 (measured)

parts.name: bms_2s
parts.note: bms_2s 40.80 x 8.00 x 2.10 (measured)

parts.name: camera
parts.note: Caddx Ant 13.99 x 14.59, 18.34 front to back (measured)

parts.name: n20_foot
parts.note: FOOT worm N20 in the housing, output up when folded (lower stub trimmed to 2 mm or single-shaft version)

parts.name: foot_shaft
parts.note: foot N20 output shaft, 9 proud, D flat facing the hull nose side

parts.name: screws_radial
parts.note: 7 x M3 x 8 countersunk (flat-head) radial screws, flush with the skin: 3 into tray disc 1, 4 into the tail spigot

parts.name: screw_ear_root
parts.note: M3 x 12 through the ear root into tray disc 1

parts.name: brg_ear
parts.note: F693ZZ in the ear, flange down in a counterbore on the outer face, inner face 0.4 proud of the fin onto the hub's inner-race boss

parts.name: kick_hub_screw
parts.note: M3 x 10 through the ear bearing into the hub end (turns with the leg); the head clamps the inner race onto the hub's printed boss

parts.name: pod_cap_L
parts.note: Printed pod cap Ø10 x 1.5: sits on the coupler end inside the pod counterbore, the M3 x 8 screw goes through it into the coupler; it overlaps the pod head by 1.4 mm so the pod cannot walk off the coupler (an M3 washer, Ø7, is smaller than the Ø7.25 pod bore and would not hold it)

parts.name: coupler_L_screw
parts.note: M3 x 8 through the pod cap into the coupler end (turns with it)

parts.name: pod_cap_R
parts.note: Printed pod cap Ø10 x 1.5: sits on the coupler end inside the pod counterbore, the M3 x 8 screw goes through it into the coupler; it overlaps the pod head by 1.4 mm so the pod cannot walk off the coupler (an M3 washer, Ø7, is smaller than the Ø7.25 pod bore and would not hold it)

parts.name: coupler_R_screw
parts.note: M3 x 8 through the pod cap into the coupler end (turns with it)

parts.name: contacts_front_springs
parts.note: 2xAA-holder springs joined by wire 2 (front of the cell bay)

parts.name: contacts_rear_plates
parts.note: flat contact plates at the back of the cell bay (B- cell 1, B+ cell 2)

parts.name: jst_charge
parts.note: JST-XH 3-pin charge socket (B-, BM, B+), header body 5.75 x 9.9 x 7.0 plus pins, recessed in the tail cap bottom seat; plug in on the bench only

parts.name: jst_loop
parts.note: JST-XH 2-pin power loop socket (header 5.75 x 7.4 x 7.0 + pins) with the shorting plug and its wire loop on top (ends at z 19.6, under the skin at 20.7): the ON switch, top of the tail cap

parts.name: antenna
parts.note: VTX u.FL 5.8 GHz antenna along the top through the disc 4 notch, tip ahead of the power socket seat (PLA is transparent to 5.8 GHz)

parts.name: xiao_antenna
parts.note: XIAO 2.4 GHz FPC antenna (comes with the XIAO ESP32S3; about 20 x 12, NOT measured): stick it flat to the inside of the hull top over the board bay, u.FL to the XIAO

parts.name: capacitor
parts.note: 470 to 1000 uF across the MP1584 5 V output (long leg to OUT+)
